process_issues.description: Correctness, security, simplicity, guards, workflow-safety and spec were not spawned. The PR only changes markdown skill prose under `.claude/`: it has no logic, no trust boundary, no new code constructs, no source a guard scans and no workflow change. It closes no issues; it cites only the spike doc's task IDs.

The context reviewer read the four refusal reasons `to-tickets` lists for `pup launch` (backlog budget, load, memory, usage window) but did not check each one against the `launchOrRefuse` internals. The docs reviewer also confirmed only `LowMemoryError` and the usage hold by name.

The conventions reviewer did not read ADR 0176, `docs/tickets/feature.md` or the writing-for-agents guidance. The docs and context reviewers did check the field names against `feature.yml` and `ticket-intake.utils.ts`.
